rules.rule: Builds must never fetch source-signing PGP keys from the network. Flag any gpg --recv-keys, --receive-keys, --locate-keys or --locate-external-keys, pacman-key --recv-keys, or download of a key file in build scripts, bin/build, helpers, workflows that build packages, or a PKGBUILD. The only allowed places are bin/refresh-pgp-keys, the WKD lookup of Omarchy's own key in build/Dockerfile, and the image bootstrap's download of pacman's distribution keyrings (archlinux-keyring, the Arch Linux ARM keyring) in build/Dockerfile.

Every fingerprint added to validpgpkeys must ship as pkgbuilds/<package>/keys/pgp/<FINGERPRINT>.asc in the same PR. A key file must be named by the full uppercase fingerprint of the primary key it contains; flag a mismatch, and flag a key file that holds more than one primary key.

A change to the "approved" list in release/owners.json lets a package directory provide another directory's package or replace a name that is not its own; pacman -Syu offers every replacement and defaults to yes. Flag every added, removed or widened approval, and ask the PR to say why it is an intended alternative (such as omarchy-dev providing omarchy) or a migration from an old package name. Flag an approval whose reason is missing or does not match the recipe.

Flag a PKGBUILD change that adds a replaces= entry, or a provides= entry naming a package that another directory under pkgbuilds/ builds or that Arch Linux ships, and ask whether the claim is intended. Flag a pkgname or pkgbase change that is not reflected in release/owners.json in the same PR.
